text:
Predicates:
Cost(test, amount) ::: The test costs amount dollars.
Cheaper(amount1, amount2) ::: amount1 is cheaper than amount2.
Provides(organization, aid, person) ::: organization provides aid to person.
ProveHardship(person) ::: person can prove economic hardship.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(person) ::: person lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(person) ::: person has few resources available to them.
Applicant(person, test) ::: person is applying to take test.
FOL ::: 
Premises:
Cost(gre, 205) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE test.
Cheaper(205, 300) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE test, which is cheaper than $300.
∀x (Applicant(x, gre) ∧ ProveHardship(x) → Provides(ets, financialAid, x)) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
∀x ((LivingInSingleParentFamily(x) ∨ FewResources(x)) → ProveHardship(x)) ::: Those living in single-parent families or having few resources available to them can prove economic hardship.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(tom) ::: Tom has few resources available to him.
Applicant(tom, gre) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE test.
Conclusion:
Provides(ets, financialAid, tom) ::: ETS provides financial aid to Tom.
